messages.subject: fix item and free abilities
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to estimate a multiple group model where i fix some of the item parameters and estimate the rest. I was expecting that this scenario would allow me to remove the restriction on the reference group, that means, that if i fix the items i don't need to also fix the distribution of the reference group. However, I cannot seem to find a way to do this. The reference group mean and var are set to 0 and 1.

Can you help?
